race.title: Midnite Built Different Handicap (Div 2)
race.verdict: EIGHTY EIGHT shaped encouragingly starting out for his shrewd connections when second at Wolverhampton recently and holds obvious claims off the same mark. Recent wide-margin winner Power of Prayer looks the clear threat under a penalty, while Taskheer has made a decent start for this yard. EIGHTY EIGHT (IRE) POWER OF PRAYER (GER) TASKHEER (IRE)
